definition: A defined character, tone, or set of behavioral traits that a language model is instructed or trained to adopt during interactions.
details: Personas are commonly configured via system prompts or fine-tuning, shaping how a model communicates (formal vs. casual, concise vs. detailed) without necessarily changing its underlying knowledge or reasoning ability.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Persona (in AI systems) — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
